title: Frederick Myers and the Society for Psychical Research's telepathy model
summary: Eric Wargo tells of Frederick Myers and the Society for Psychical Research's telepathy model, about 1882 at England, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: this was presumed to be telepathy that was the model that was introduced by Frederick Myers in 1882

plain: A writer named Eric Wargo, speaking with a podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about how strange mental experiences such as knowing things at a distance were explained in the past. Wargo says these were presumed to be telepathy, mind-to-mind communication, a model introduced in 1882 by Frederick Myers of the Society for Psychical Research, an English group that studied such claims. He raises it because he thinks the same experiences may have a different explanation, such as information coming from the future.
